posts.title: Out now: Nobody’s Baby!
posts.description: A wild baby appears… The second volume of the Dorothy Gentleman series is now available from Tordotcom in your format of choice! And check out the spectacular cover art by Marcos Chin: Cover art by Marcos Chin: three figures in antique frock coats stare down at a baby in a bassinet. Stars and galaxies shine in the tall windows all around.

posts.title: Cover Reveal: Murder by Memory
posts.description: I am delighted to show you all the cover for Murder by Memory , first in the Dorothy Gentleman sci-fi mystery series! One of the great thrills of being an author is seeing things you’ve imagined become actual things you can point to on a book cover.
